# netmaker_network (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Netmaker network by name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Network name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `address_range` (String)
- `address_range6` (String)
- `auto_join` (Boolean)
- `auto_remove` (Boolean)
- `auto_remove_tags` (List of String)
- `auto_remove_threshold` (Number)
- `default_enrollment_key` (Attributes) The network's auto-created default enrollment key's editable settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default_enrollment_key))
- `default_token` (String, Sensitive)
- `default_value` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `jit_enabled` (Boolean)

<a id="nestedatt--default_enrollment_key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `default_enrollment_key`

Read-Only:

- `auto_assign_gateway` (Boolean)
- `gateway_id` (String) ID of the relay/gateway node devices enrolled with this key are auto-relayed through, if any.
- `tags` (List of String)
